source: R03: Y. Wu et al., Int. J. Mech. Sci. 305 (2025) 110810, doi:10.1016/j.ijmecsci.2025.110810 (ref/reference/R03_Wu_2025_dual_zone_MBE_heater.pdf)
machine: 4 x 6-inch MBE heater (CETC 48): dual-zone pyrolytic-graphite heating plate, Mo/Ta reflecting and insulating plates, Mo platen and backing ring, GaAs substrates

measurement.method: Canon EOS 6D Mark II through a bottom viewport, 660 nm narrow-band filter plus ND16, 14-bit RAW grey levels mapped to temperature with a FLUKE Endurance pyrometer at the substrate centre; stated error +/-2 K (Sec. 3.5)
measurement.profiles: lines drawn manually across one substrate (Fig. B5); x axis 0-0.15 m spans one 6-inch substrate, which sits off the heater axis on the 4 x 6-inch platen

radial_temperature_difference_K.provenance: values printed in the panels of Fig. 14 (exact as printed)

profile_shape_note: At 863-983 K the measured radial profiles are M-shaped with maxima near 0.02 m and 0.11 m; R03's simulated profiles peak near 0.00 m and 0.13 m and drop steeply at the edge. The shapes are not reproduced by R03's own model, so profile shape is a weak target; the radial temperature differences are the usable quantity. Fig. 15 surface values and Fig. 16 maps are not digitized.
interpretation_not_stated: LA + LB = 194 mm is read as the heater's radial extent (inner zone to 174 mm radius, outer ring 174-194 mm), consistent with a 4 x 6-inch platen; the heater meander path, platen and hull dimensions, and zone powers are not given.
